body.x: The outstanding Handle Band for bicycle caught the attendees' attentions on the show floor at CES.

'Universial Smartphone Bar Mount' that NiteIze(www.niteize.com) showcased, can be put on bicycle. This product allows to securely attach a device to the bar of bike, jogging stroller, or shopping cart.
The bar mount is made with lightweight, expandable silicone with an aluminum base.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
